∀ {k : Nat} {g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance} {m : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem},

    Eq.{1} (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.KV) k →
      DisequalityDispersion.Machine.RepListOf DisequalityDispersion.Machine.RepNat m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN
          (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP) (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.SRCS)
          (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.sources (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g)) →
        DisequalityDispersion.Machine.RepListOf DisequalityDispersion.Machine.RepPair m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN
            (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP) (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.SYMS)
            (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.symbols (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g)) →
          DisequalityDispersion.Machine.RepListOf DisequalityDispersion.Machine.RepNode m
              DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP)
              (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.NODES)
              (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.nodes (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g)) →
            Eq.{1} (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.XV)
                (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.x (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g)) →
              Eq.{1} (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.YV)
                  (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.y (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g)) →
                Eq.{1} (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.TV)
                    (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.t (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g)) →
                  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.RepListOf DisequalityDispersion.Machine.RepPair m
                      DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP)
                      (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.TESTS)
                      (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.tests (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g)) →
                    DisequalityDispersion.Machine.RepListOf DisequalityDispersion.Machine.RepNat m
                        DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP)
                        (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.OUTS) (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.outs g) →
                      Eq.{1} (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.NN)
                          (List.length.{0}
                            (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.nodes
                              (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g))) →
                        Eq.{1} (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.KK)
                            (List.length.{0}
                              (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.sources
                                (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g))) →
                          Eq.{1} (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.MM)
                              (List.length.{0}
                                (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.symbols
                                  (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g))) →
                            DisequalityDispersion.Machine.InstCtx k g m
